verses.text: Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isacar chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Jasub yet' winhaj Simrón.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Tola chi': Haton winhaj Uzi, winhaj Refaías, winhaj Jeriel, winhaj Jahmai, winhaj Jibsam yet' winhaj Semuel. Haton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal. Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj rey David, 22 mil 600 sb'isul heb' soldado te jelan t'a owal t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Tola chi'.

Ha winhaj Uzi chi' ay jun yuninal winh, haton winhaj Israhías. Ha winhaj Israhías chi' ay chanhwanh yuninal winh: Winhaj Micael, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Isías. Ha winh yet' heb' winh yuninal chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal.
Yujto tzijtum heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' yal yuninal junjun heb' winh, yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh, ay 36 mil sb'isul heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a owal.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado yinhtilal heb' chanhwanh yuninal winhaj Isacar chi' te jelan t'a owal, ay 87 mil heb'.
Oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Benjamín: Haton winhaj Bela, winhaj Bequer yet' winhaj Jediael.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bela chi', owanh heb' winh: Winhaj Ezbón, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Uziel, winhaj Jerimot yet' winhaj Iri. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal. Haxo sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh, ay 22 mil 34 heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bequer: Haton winhaj Zemira, winhaj Joás, winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Omri, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Abías, winhaj Anatot yet' winhaj Alemet.
Ha sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh, ay 20 mil 200 heb'.

Ha winhaj Jediael ay jun yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Bilhán. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bilhán chi': Haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Aod, winhaj Quenaana, winhaj Zetán, winhaj Tarsis yet' winhaj Ahisahar.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal. Haxo sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', ay 17 mil 200 heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ir, haton winhaj Supim yet' winhaj Hupim. Haxo yuninal winhaj Aher, haton winhaj Husim.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Neftalí: Haton winhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Salum. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Jacob yet' ix Bilha.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Manasés yet' ix aj Siria schab'il yetb'eyum: Haton winhaj Asriel yet' winhaj Maquir, smam winhaj Galaad.

Ha winhaj Maquir chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Maaca, yinhtilal winhaj Hupim yet' winhaj Supim. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Maquir chi', haton winhaj Zelofehad. Ha jun winh chi', anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay.

Haxo ix Maaca yetb'eyum winhaj Maquir chi', ix alji chawanh swinak unin ix. Peres ix yak' ix sb'iej jun, haxo junxo Seres. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Peres chi', Ulam sb'i winh b'ab'el, Requem sb'i junxo winh.
Haxo jun yuninal winhaj Ulam chi', haton winhaj Bedán. Ha heb' winh tik a winhaj Galaad yuninal winhaj Maquir ay yinhtilal heb' winh, haton winh yixchikin winhaj Manasés.
Ha jun ix yanab' winhaj Maquir chi': Haton ix Hamolequet, haton ix snun winhaj Isod, winhaj Abiezer yet' winhaj Mahala.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semida: Haton winhaj Ahián, winhaj Siquem, winhaj Likhi yet' winhaj Aniam.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Efraín sb'eynhejkot t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Sutela, winhaj Bered, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Elada, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Sutela. Ay chawanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Efraín chi', haton winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Elad, milb'ilcham heb' winh yuj heb' kajan t'a Gat, yujto ix emk'och heb' yelk'ej nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' kajan t'a Gat chi'.
Ha winhaj Efraín smam heb' winh chi', tzijtum k'uhal ix te kus winh. Ix jawi heb' sk'ab'yok winh yak' sniwanil sk'o'ol.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji pax junxo yuninal winhaj Efraín chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum, Bería ix yak' winh sb'iej, yujto ix ek' jun niwan kusk'olal chi' t'a heb'.
Ha ix Seera yisil winhaj Bería chi', a ix ix b'oank'e chonhab' Bet-horón jun ay t'a yalanh yet' Bet-horón ay t'a yib'anh yet' chonhab' Uzen-seera.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Bería sb'eynhejkot t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Refa, winhaj Resef, winhaj Telah, winhaj Tahán, winhaj Laadán, winhaj Amiud, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Nun, winhaj Josué.

Haxo slu'um heb' winh b'aj kajan: Haton Betel yet' Naarán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, Gezer t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' Siquem masanto sk'och t'a Ayah. Ix scha juntzanh chonhab' chi' heb' winh yet' yaldea'il.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés, ix kajnaj heb' winh t'a chonhab' Bet-seán, Taanac, Meguido, Dor yet' yaldea'il juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Haton t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix kajnaj heb' yinhtilal José, yuninalkan winhaj Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aser: Haton winhaj Imna, winhaj Isúa, winhaj Isúi, winhaj Bería yet' ix Sera yanab' heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bería chi': Haton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malquiel smam winhaj Birzavit.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Heber chi': Haton winhaj Jaflet, winhaj Semer, winhaj Hotam yet' ix Súa yanab' heb' winh.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaflet chi': Haton winhaj Pasac, winhaj Bimhal yet' winhaj Asvat.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semer chi': Haton winhaj Ahí, winhaj Rohga, winhaj Jehúba yet' winhaj Aram.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Helem: Haton winhaj Sofa, winhaj Imna, winhaj Seles yet' winhaj Amal.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sofa chi': Haton winhaj Súa, winhaj Harnefer, winhaj Súal, winhaj Beri, winhaj Imra,
winhaj Beser, winhaj Hod, winhaj Sama, winhaj Silsa, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Beera.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeter: Haton winhaj Jefone, winhaj Pispa yet' winhaj Ara.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ula: Haton winhaj Ara, winhaj Haniel yet' winhaj Rezia.

Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal Aser heb' winh. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal, te niwak pax yelk'och heb' winh. Ha sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Aser chi', ay 26 mil heb'.
